curriculum.subject: LANGUAGE_ARTS
curriculum.description: Students listen to short audio passages and select the most important facts to summarize the core events. Focus: Identifying specific key details in informational and narrative text. Examples: The main goal of the scientist, the steps taken by the character, the final outcome of the experiment, the location of the event, the time period described, the reason for the character's choice, the central problem encountered, the solution reached. Constraints: The passage-studio will present a 100-word audio track followed by multiple-choice options to identify the top three key facts, ensuring all answers are directly supported by the text.

status: authored; catalog-checked; each binding generator-probed once; not hydrated as a lesson; not runtime-tested
learnerAction: Listen to a ~100-word passage and pick the three most important facts, leaving out true but minor ones.
